parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: Performs a dry run. The system checks the request without updating the endpoint groups. The system checks whether the required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and the service limits are met. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned.
false (default): Performs a dry run and then sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the system updates the endpoint groups
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会批量修改某个监听下的终端节点组。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回HTTP 2xx状态码。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

false: No

true：是。

false：否

fields.help_zh: 端点组配置中的API密钥
fields.name: api_keys

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable client IP address preservation by using the automatic retrieval method. Valid values:

true: Enables client IP address preservation.

false (default): Disables client IP address preservation.


By default, client IP address preservation is disabled for endpoint groups associated with UDP or TCP listeners. You can configure this feature based on your business requirements.
By default, client IP address preservation is enabled for endpoint groups associated with HTTP or HTTPS listeners. The client IP address is obtained from the X-Forwarded-For header. You cannot disable this feature.
You cannot set both EnableClientIPPreservation and EnableProxyProtocol to true.
For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158080.html
fields.help_zh:
是否使用自动获取方式开启保持客户端源 IP 功能，取值：

true：开启保持客户端源 IP 功能。

false（默认值）：不开启保持客户端源IP功能。


UDP/TCP 监听对应的终端节点组默认不开启保持客户端源IP，您可根据业务需要配置。
HTTP（S）监听对应的终端节点组默认开启保持客户端源IP，通过X-Forwarded-For头字段获取。不支持关闭。
EnableClientIPPreservation与 EnableProxyProtocol不能同时为 true。
更多信息请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158080.html
fields.name: enable_client_ip_preservation

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable client IP address preservation by using the Proxy Protocol. Valid values:

true: Enables client IP address preservation.

false (default): Disables client IP address preservation.
This parameter is supported only for endpoint groups associated with TCP listeners.
You cannot set both EnableClientIPPreservation and EnableProxyProtocol to true.
For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158080.html
fields.help_zh:
是否使用ProxyProtocol方式开启保持客户端源IP功能，取值：

true：开启保持客户端源IP功能。

false（默认值）：不开启保持客户端源IP功能。
仅支持TCP监听对应的终端节点组配置。
EnableClientIPPreservation与 EnableProxyProtocol不能同时为 true。
更多信息请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158080.html
fields.name: enable_proxy_protocol

The private IP address of the elastic network interface (ENI).

弹性网卡的私网IP地址。

当终端节点类型为ENI时，可以选择配置该参数，如果不配置默认为ENI的主私网IP地址
fields.name: sub_address

fields.help_en:
The type of the endpoint. Valid values:

Domain: a custom domain name.
Ip: a custom IP address.
IpTarget: a custom private IP.
PublicIp: an Alibaba Cloud public IP address.
ECS: an Alibaba Cloud ECS instance.
SLB: an Alibaba Cloud SLB instance.
ALB: an Alibaba Cloud ALB instance.
OSS: an Alibaba Cloud OSS instance.
ENI: an Alibaba Cloud elastic network interface (ENI).
NLB: an Alibaba Cloud NLB instance.

If the endpoint type is set to ECS, ENI, SLB, ALB, NLB, or IpTarget, and the service-linked role does not exist, the system automatically creates a service-linked role named AliyunServiceRoleForGaVpcEndpoint.
If the endpoint type is set to ALB, and the service-linked role does not exist, the system automatically creates a service-linked role named AliyunServiceRoleForGaAlb.
If the endpoint type is set to OSS, and the service-linked role does not exist, the system automatically creates a service-linked role named AliyunServiceRoleForGaOss.
For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178360.html
fields.help_zh:
终端节点类型。

Domain：自定义域名。
Ip：自定义IP。
IpTarget：自定义私网IP。
PublicIp：阿里云公网IP。
ECS：阿里云ECS实例。
SLB：阿里云SLB实例。
ALB：阿里云ALB实例。
OSS：阿里云OSS实例。
ENI：阿里云弹性网卡。
NLB：阿里云NLB实例。

终端节点类型取值为ECS、ENI、SLB、ALB、NLB或IpTarget时，如果服务关联角色不存在，系统会自动创建一个名称为AliyunServiceRoleForGaVpcEndpoint的服务关联角色。
终端节点类型取值为ALB时，如果服务关联角色不存在，系统会自动创建一个名称为AliyunServiceRoleForGaAlb的服务关联角色。
终端节点类型取值为OSS时，如果服务关联角色不存在，系统会自动创建一个名称为AliyunServiceRoleForGaOss的服务关联角色。
更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178360.html

The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC).

You can specify at most one VPC ID for an endpoint group associated with an intelligent routing listener.

The weight of the endpoint.

终端节点的权重。

如果某个终端节点的权重设置为0，全球加速将终止向该终端节点分发流量，请您谨慎操作

描述长度最大 200 字符，不能以 http://和 https://开头

The name of the endpoint group.

终端节点组的名称。

名称长度为 1~128 个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）下划线（_）和短划线（-）

fields.help_en:
The IP version of the backend service. Valid values:  
IPv4 (default): GA communicates with the endpoint service only by using IPv4 addresses.  
IPv6: GA communicates with the endpoint service only by using IPv6 addresses.  
ProtocolAffinity: GA uses the same IP version to communicate with the endpoint service as the IP version used by the client request
fields.help_zh:
后端IP地址协议。取值：  
IPv4：（默认值）：GA仅使用IPv4地址与终端节点服务通信。  
IPv6：GA仅使用IPv6地址与终端节点服务通信。  
ProtocolAffinity：GA与终端节点服务通信的IP协议与客户端请求使用的IP协议相同

fields.help_en:
The version of the protocol for the backend service for the endpoint associated with an intelligent routing listener. Valid values:

HTTP1.1 (default): HTTP/1.1.

HTTP2: HTTP/2.

You can specify the version of the protocol for the backend service only when the EndpointRequestProtocol parameter is set to HTTPS
fields.help_zh:
智能路由类型监听的终端节点后端服务协议版本。取值：

HTTP1.1（默认值）：HTTP1.1版本。

HTTP2：HTTP2版本。

仅当EndpointRequestProtocol（终端节点后端服务协议）值为HTTPS时，支持配置终端节点后端服务协议版本
fields.name: endpoint_protocol_version

fields.help_en:
The protocol for the backend service. Valid values:
HTTP: HTTP.
HTTPS: HTTPS.

You can specify this parameter only when you create an endpoint group for an HTTP or HTTPS listener instance.
For an HTTP listener instance, the protocol for the backend service supports and only supports HTTP
fields.help_zh:
后端服务协议。取值：
HTTP：HTTP协议。
HTTPS：HTTPS协议。

仅为HTTP或HTTPS协议的监听实例创建终端节点组时才支持配置该项。
对于HTTP协议的监听实例，后端服务协议支持且仅支持HTTP

fields.help_en:
The listener port.

Valid values: 1 to 65499.

For TCP listeners: Port mappings are not supported for virtual endpoint groups. If a virtual endpoint group already exists under the listener, you cannot configure port mappings for the default endpoint group. If port mappings are already configured for the default endpoint group, you cannot add a virtual endpoint group.
After you configure port mappings, the following limits apply to subsequent listener modifications: You cannot modify the listener protocol, except for switching between HTTP and HTTPS.
Listener port: The modified listener port range must include all listener ports configured in the current port mappings. For example, if the listener port range is 80 to 82 and port mappings are configured to endpoint ports 100 to 102, you cannot change the listener port range to 80 to 81
fields.help_zh:
监听端口。

取值范围：1~65499。

对于TCP监听：虚拟终端节点组不支持配置端口映射。如果监听下已存在虚拟终端节点组，则默认终端节点组无法配置端口映射。如果默认终端节点组已配置端口映射，则无法添加虚拟终端节点组。
配置端口映射后，后续监听变更时有以下限制：除HTTP和HTTPS之间的协议切换以外，不支持修改监听协议。
监听端口：您修改的监听端口范围必须包含当前所配置端口映射的全量监听端口。例如，当监听端口范围为80-82，并配置端口映射至终端节点端口100-102时，后续修改监听端口范围时，不支持修改为80-81
